title: Accounts
shortDescription: Manage all your bank accounts, wallets, and cash in one place
description: Track balances and transactions across multiple accounts. Add bank accounts, digital wallets, credit cards, and cash.
steps: Enter account name and initial balance
Choose account type (Bank, Wallet, Cash, etc.)
tips: You can archive accounts you no longer use
Set low balance alerts in settings

title: Categories
description: Create income and expense categories to track where your money goes. Customize with icons and colors.
tips: Use specific categories for better insights

title: Budgets
shortDescription: Set monthly budgets for different categories
description: Control spending by setting budget limits. Get alerts when you approach or exceed your budget.
tips: Use budget insights to improve spending

title: Bills
description: Never miss a payment. Track rent, subscriptions, utilities, and other recurring bills with reminders.
tips: Mark bills as paid when completed
Get reminders 3 days before due date

title: Recurring Transactions
description: Set up recurring transactions for salary, rent, subscriptions. They'll be created automatically on schedule.
tips: Pause or delete when no longer needed

title: Trips & Split Expenses
shortDescription: Manage group trips and split expenses
description: Create trips, add participants, link transactions, and split expenses automatically. Perfect for group travel!

title: Auto Import
description: Automatically detect and parse financial transactions from bank and wallet notification messages. Review and import with one tap.
tips: Edit amounts or categories if needed

title: Backup & Restore
description: Export your data to JSON format for backup. Import previously exported data to restore transactions and settings.

title: Statistics & Reports
description: View detailed charts, graphs, and reports. Analyze spending by category, time period, and account.

title: Security
description: Secure your app with PIN or biometric authentication. Keep your financial information private.
